$comment: Layout and policy for lean-LLM-harness — the portable living research methodology. Consuming programmes (e.g. screen-medium-foundations) pin a release of this repo and supply their own programme docs, foundations, and gate instances. See METHOD.md and docs/consuming-programmes.md.

context.$comment: Cold-session loading for this method repo.

reproduction.$comment: Method-repo tiers: lineage admission + repository verification once govern.py is present.

structure.$comment: DECLARATION of what this method repository must contain. Not derived from the filesystem.
structure.living_path_prefixes_rationale: Method surfaces may change under controlled PR admission; technique records and releases follow lineage/seal rules in METHOD.md.
structure.pin_exempt_path_prefixes_rationale: Living method docs and tooling are not sealed experiment artifacts. Sealed method releases live under releases/.
structure.readme_only_roots_rationale: Scientific/method roots expose README.md; detailed rules live under infrastructure/ and METHOD.md.
structure.allowed_root_markdown_rationale: Agent instructions and the living method paper live at repo root.
structure.sealed_corrections_rationale: No sealed study migrations in the method repo yet.

policy.$comment: Executable restatements of METHOD.md commitments. Changing these changes what the method enforces.
policy.retrospective_rationale: Retrospective work may not claim derivation or support; proceed-as-promotion requires a named candidate.
policy.promotion_rationale: Promotion requires machine-checkable evidence or a cited source — assertion alone is insufficient.
policy.new_claim_rigor_rationale: New claims must declare class, premises, falsifier, scope, gates, evidence, dependencies, and verification links.
policy.verification_plan_rationale: Heavy protocols must declare independent replay, certificate, formal proof, or mutation evidence before execution.
policy.freeze_rationale: Preregistration must be committed before decisive outcomes are viewed.
policy.lineage_required_rationale: Borrowed techniques must have lineage/techniques records and registry entries before adoption; silent assimilation is forbidden.
policy.conditional_implication_open_premise_rat: Checked implications are not derived while named premises remain open.
